terrestrial [[planet]] located in the [[Savareen sector]]'s [[Yerbana system]] within the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. During the [[High Republic Era]], in [[230 BBY]], the planet came to be located within the [[Occlusion Zone]], the region of [[Realspace|space]] controlled by the [[Nihil]] [[Pirate|marauders]] surrounded by the impenetrable [[Stormwall]] barrier. While the world was in the Occlusion Zone, a [[Republic Defense Coalition|Republic Defense Corps]] station near Yerbana was [[Attack on a Republic Defense Coalition transport|attacked]] by Nihil. In [[228 BBY]], the [[Mission to Planet X (Jedi Order)|Stormwall fell]], and the Nihil surrendered to the Republic, with worlds formerly within the Occlusion Zone being welcomed back into the Republic if they so chose. In [[19 BBY]], during the [[Outer Rim Sieges]] of the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], a [[Battle of Yerbana|battle]] was fought on Yerbana between the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] and the [[Separatist Droid Army]]. The battle resulted in a Republic victory after [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[501st Legion]] came to the aid of fellow [[Jedi]] [[General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and the [[212th Attack Battalion]]. Skywalker defeated the Separatists by faking a surrender and drawing out the [[Unidentified super tactical droid (Yerbana)|super tactical droid]] that was leading the [[droid]] forces, enabling the Republic to capture Yerbana. The [[HoloNet News]] [[Journalist|anchor]] [[Dorna Parros]] reported a story of a [[KX-series security droid]] recovering stolen property from raiders on Yerbana in [[3 ABY]], and [[author]] [[Kitrin Braves]] briefly covered the Battle of Yerbana in her [[Book|biography]] of the [[Skywalker family]], titled [[Skywalker: A Family at War (in-universe)|''Skywalker: A Family at War'']], no earlier than [[35 ABY]]. ==Description== {{Quote|We've been running ever since. Hiding out on one of Yerbana's moons.|Lieutenant Visma Tarko|}} [[File:Yerbana_map.png|thumb|left|300px|Yerbana was located along the Triellus Trade Route in the Outer Rim Territories.]] Yerbana was a terrestrial [[planet]] within the [[Yerbana system]] in the [[Savareen sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. Situated in grid square Q-17 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]], Yerbana was connected by the [[Triellus Trade Route]] to the planets''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]''''[[Poe Dameron: Free Fall]]'' [[Arkanis]] and [[Llanic]] and was located just off the [[Corellian Run]].[[Star Wars Galaxy Map (poster)|''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map poster]] It had multiple [[moon]]s, a type I [[atmosphere]] that was breathable, and a surface that had [[ocean]]s; [[mountain]]s covered in [[Color|green]] [[Plant|vegetation]]; and canyons. The planet's [[City|cities]] were connected by bridges and often nestled among permanent [[cloud]]s atop flat mountains high above the surface. ==History== ===High Republic Era=== {{Quote|I mean, Lieutenant Tarko and I had been assigned to a station near Yerbana. We were on a transport with Six-En when our shuttle was attacked by Nihil. We got out in an escape pod.|Corporal Elping Tsoo recounts his capture by the Nihil|}} [[File:Yerbana-OcclusionZone.png|thumb|right|300px|Yerbana was within the original borders of the Occlusion Zone.]] During the [[High Republic Era]],''[[Star Wars: The High Republic: Chronicles of the Jedi]]'' — Based on corresponding data for the [[Occlusion Zone]] Yerbana was located within a section of the Outer Rim designated as the [[Galactic Frontier]] by the [[Galactic Republic]]. The region was considered far enough from [[the galaxy]]'s central regions to warrant the dispatching of [[Scout|explorers]] to its worlds. In [[230 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: The High Republic Character Encyclopedia]]'' states the [[Stormwall]] was originally [[Deployment of the stormseeds|deployed]] in [[230 BBY]]. ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' shows Yerbana within the original boundary of the Stormwall, thus confirming that the [[planet]] was within the [[Occlusion Zone]] in 230 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]]. Yerbana fell within the borders of the [[Occlusion Zone]], a region of [[Realspace|space]] controlled by the [[Pirate|marauder]] group known as the [[Nihil]], after the [[Deployment of the stormseeds|formation]] of the [[Stormwall]],''[[The High Republic: The Eye of Darkness]]'' While the planet was in the Occlusion Zone, [[Lieutenant]] [[Visma Tarko]] and [[Corporal]] [[Elping Tsoo]] of the [[Republic Defense Coalition|Republic Defense Corps]] were assigned to a [[Unidentified Republic Defense Coalition station|station]] near Yerbana with the [[protocol droid]] [[C-06N|See-Zerosixen]] when their [[Unidentified Republic Defense Coalition transport|transport]] came under [[Attack on a Republic Defense Coalition transport|attack]] by the Nihil. The trio fled via an [[escape pod]] and hid on one of Yerbana's moons, where they stowed away on a [[Starship|ship]] that was itself captured by the Nihil. [[Standard month|Months]] later, in [[228 BBY]],Per the reasoning [[:Template:StarlightDate|here]], the events of "[[Tales from the Occlusion Zone: Survivors]]," which take place one [[Standard year|year]] and a [[Standard month|month]] after the [[destruction of Starlight Beacon]], must take place in [[228 BBY]]. the officers recounted the events near Yerbana to [[Captain]]s [[Joss Adren|Joss]] and [[Pikka Adren]]. That year,{{TrialsoftheJediDate|23|the [[Nihil]]'s surrender}} the [[Mission to Planet X (Jedi Order)|Stormwall fell]] and the Nihil surrendered to the Republic, dissolving the Occlusion Zone. Worlds formerly in the Occlusion Zone were welcomed back into the Republic if they so chose. However, some opted to remain independent, while Nihil [[warlord]]s remained in control of others.''[[The High Republic: Trials of the Jedi]]'' ===Clone Wars=== {{Quote|Anakin, where are you?''"
"''I'm right here.|Anakin Skywalker arrives to assist Obi-Wan Kenobi during the Battle of Yerbana|audio=Kenobi-Anakin-where-are-you.flac|}} [[File:BattleOfYerbana-OFNF.png|thumb|left|300px|The 212th Attack Battalion struggles to gain ground on Yerbana.]] During the [[Outer Rim Sieges]] of the [[Clone Wars]] between the Galactic Republic and the [[Separatist Crisis|secessionist]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], in [[19 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[Old Friends Not Forgotten]]" to [[19 BBY]]. military priority was given to key planets, such as Yerbana, [[Felucia]], and [[Cato Neimoidia]].{{EncyclopediaCite|The End of the Clone Wars}} Yerbana was the site of a Republic [[Battle of Yerbana|offensive]] aimed at territories still under Separatist control. The fighting took place on the planet's surface and in its atmosphere, contested by the forces of the [[Grand Army of the Republic]]'s [[501st Legion]] and [[212th Attack Battalion]] against the [[Separatist Droid Army]]. The Battle of Yerbana{{OST|Star Wars: The Clone Wars - The Final Season (Episodes 9-12) (Original Soundtrack)}} was fought on multiple fronts, with the 501st, under the [[Commanding officer|leadership]] of [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]], and the 212th, under [[Jedi]] [[General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], fighting separately. Eventually, Skywalker and the 501st were victorious in their engagement and moved to assist Kenobi and the 212th, who were struggling to make advancements on a large bridge outside a nearby [[Yerbana city|city]]. Upon arrival on the bridge, Skywalker informed Kenobi that the 501st had come to his aid and teased him for hiding behind cover while the inhabitants of the nearby city suffered at the hands of the Separatists. Skywalker's plan started with him calling for a ceasefire and declaring surrender to the [[droid]] forces in an attempt to draw the enemy's [[Unidentified super tactical droid (Yerbana)|super tactical droid]] into the open. Meanwhile, [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex]] led [[clone jetpack trooper]]s of the 501st underneath the bridge. [[File:YerbanaJetpackTroopers.png|thumb|right|300px|The jetpack troopers of the 501st flank the droid army.]] After the [[ST-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|tactical droid]] appeared in the open, having come out to see why the droid [[army]] had ceased fire, Skywalker [[Telekinesis|pulled]] the droid toward him with [[the Force]] and decapitated it with [[Skywalker lightsaber|his lightsaber]]. The [[Clone trooper|clones]] underneath then activated their [[jetpack]]s and flew up over the bridge, flanking the droid army on both sides. The [[Republic Military|Republic's forces]] quickly defeated the droid army, and Skywalker and Kenobi were soon called back to a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] to receive a communication from the former Jedi [[Ahsoka Tano]]. The battle for Yerbana ended in a Republic victory, taking control of the planet from the Separatists. ===Imperial Era and beyond=== {{Quote|An Imperial KX droid became something of a local hero when it recovered a family's property from raiders on Yerbana. The droid delivered the stolen items after single-handedly destroying the raiders' outpost.|Dorna Parros, HoloNet News|audio=Yerbana-Outlaws.flac|''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]''}} After the Republic transitioned into the [[Galactic Empire]] following the conclusion of the Clone Wars, Yerbana fell under Imperial influence and the [[Logistics, Deployment, and Allotment Center]] was run by the Empire on the planet. During the [[Galactic Civil War]], operatives of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] managed to infiltrate and set up a [[Rebel Hideout|makeshift hideout]] within the base to gather intelligence on Imperial activities, contact other rebels, and recharge without the Empire's notice. In [[3 ABY]],{{OutlawsDate}} the [[HoloNet News]] [[Journalist|anchor]] [[Dorna Parros]] relayed a story about a [[KX-series security droid]] recovering the property of a family from raiders on Yerbana. The droid was said to have delivered the items to their rightful owners after destroying the raiders' outpost single-handedly, earning it the reputation of a local hero. Sometime after the publishing of the [[historian]] [[Beaumont Kin]]'s [[book]] ''[[The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]'' in [[35 ABY]],{{SkywalkerFamilyAtWarDate}} the journalist [[Kitrin Braves]] published''[[Skywalker: A Family at War]]'' her biography on the [[Skywalker family]], [[Skywalker: A Family at War (in-universe)|''Skywalker: A Family at War'']],{{SW|url=news/star-wars-reads-recommendations|text=Our ''Star Wars'' Reads Picks For Every Type of Reader in Your Life}} which included a short description of the Battle of Yerbana during the Clone Wars. ==Locations== {{Quote|Master, I mean no disrespect. If you want, I can hide here with you, and we can let the people in the city suffer longer.|Skywalker is sarcastic toward Kenobi for hiding behind cover|audio=Anakin-hide-here-with-you.flac|}} Yerbana was home to a city with towering [[skyscraper]]s. On the outskirts of the city, a massive bridge stretched over a deep chasm. The Republic Defense Corps had a station near Yerbana. The Galactic Empire later operated a logistics center on the planet, which rebel agents managed to infiltrate and also secretly operate out of. ==Behind the scenes== This article considers the map, which is the newer source, to be correct. [[File:Ilm-rebel-hideout-21.jpg|thumb|left|300px|ILM's Rebel Hideout employee lounge]] The planet also serves as the fictional setting for an [[Rebel Hideout (real-world)|employee lounge]] within [[One Letterman]], [[Industrial Light & Magic]]'s (ILM) [[Wikipedia:San Francisco|San Francisco]] headquarters. The "Rebel Hideout" was designed and built over a decade to look and feel like an in-universe ''Star Wars'' location, with the in-universe location's name, Logistics, Deployment, and Allotment Center, intentionally sharing an acronym with the campus's former name, the Letterman Digital Arts Center. A playful backstory was imagined for the lounge, which placed the Rebel Hideout on Yerbana. While the actual lounge had its opening in [[May]] [[2024]], information regarding it was not released publicly until the article "Welcome to the Rebel Hideout: ILM's Employee-made 'Star Wars' Gathering Place" was published on ILM's website on [[August 26]], [[2025]].{{ILM|url=rebel-hideout-lounge-ilm-lucasfilm-star-wars|text=Welcome to the Rebel Hideout: ILM's Employee-made 'Star Wars' Gathering Place}} ===Concept art gallery=== {{Gallery |source="[[Old Friends Not Forgotten]]" |storyboards= |concept= File:City-gateway-SOP-Kirk.jpg|City Gateway SOP by Andre Kirk File:City-gateway-concept-Kirk.jpg|City Gateway Barricade SOP by Andre Kirk File:Yerbana-lighting-concept.png|Lighting concept by Molly Denmark |digital= |in-progress= }} ==Appearances== *{{InsiderCite|224|Tales from the Occlusion Zone: Survivors}} {{Mo}} *{{TCW|Old Friends Not Forgotten}} {{1st}} *{{TBB|Aftermath (episode)}} {{Flash}} *[[Rebel Hideout (real-world)|Rebel Hideout]] *''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]'' {{Mo}} ==Sources== {{ScrollBox|content= {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Yerbana}} *{{SWYouTube|ZLW2jkd6E7g|Star Wars: The Clone Wars | Official Trailer | Disney+}} {{1stp}} *{{SWYouTube|LVRsYnTXP-Q|Star Wars: The Clone Wars | Final TV Spot | Disney+}} *{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/old-friends-not-forgotten-episode-guide|text="Old Friends Not Forgotten" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} *{{SWKidsYouTube|-ZUN_KtmahE|Bucket List: "Old Friends Not Forgotten" – Star Wars: The Clone Wars|nolive=1}} *{{SWYouTube|series=Clone Wars Download|text="Old Friends Not Forgotten"|video=YCzk9Ghl9WA|sw_url=video/clone-wars-download-old-friends-not-forgotten}} *{{OST|Star Wars: The Clone Wars -
